m3fd_headlights_ir.title: Blinded by headlights
m3fd_headlights_ir.caption: Rainy night road: oncoming headlights wash out the nearest car in a regular camera, while a far car shows mostly through its tail lights and is faint in thermal. The model reads both images together and finds all of them.
m3fd_headlights_ir.split: val (local split, image 00694; not trained on)
m3fd_headlights_ir.license: M3FD: released by the TarDAL authors for research; no explicit image license found - treat as research / non-commercial, attribute Liu et al. CVPR 2022
m3fd_headlights_ir.model: D-FINE-seg L detection, 4-channel RGB+thermal input, trained on M3FD train, conf 0.5
m3fd_headlights_ir.notes: Model input is the 4-channel visible+thermal stack; this file shows the thermal (IR) view of the same registered pair (twin asset with identical predictions: m3fd_headlights_vis). 640x640, COCO init, 55 epochs. M3FD test: mAP50 0.931, mAP50-95 0.656, F1 0.883.

radio_galaxies.title: Radio galaxies and their host galaxies
radio_galaxies.caption: Radio galaxies from the EMU pilot survey with the infrared galaxy that hosts each one.
radio_galaxies.dataset: RadioGalaxyNET (Gupta et al., PASA 2024; CSIRO DAP 61068)
radio_galaxies.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (images re-rendered for display: infrared gray, radio amber)
radio_galaxies.model: D-FINE-seg S keypoints (1 host keypoint), trained on RadioGalaxyNET train, conf 0.5, class-agnostic NMS
radio_galaxies.notes: Picked among images the model gets fully right (all sources, right class, host OKS >= 0.5, no extra boxes). Benchmark: 67.1 box AP / 70.5 host keypoint AP vs Gal-DINO 53.7 / 48.1, repo radiogalaxynet-dfine-vs-galdino.
